title: Shadowed in Vector Space: Zero-Label Detection and Resolution of Stale Version Collisions in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
description: We formalize the Stale Version Collision problem in RAG, show a pooling dilution bound for mean-pooled embeddings, report that MMR re-ranking increased stale-answer rate in our setup, and present SCS*, a zero-label PyTorch pruner. Code, data logs and PDF included.
